summary: The community.digitalocean collection is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 13 unless it regains a maintainer.
questions: Is community.digitalocean being removed from Ansible?
When will the DigitalOcean collection be dropped?

answer_card.title: community.digitalocean is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: As of Ansible 12.2.0, `community.digitalocean` is deprecated and will be **removed from Ansible 13** unless someone starts maintaining it again before then.
